functions.plate_comment: GameServerManager::AssignServer: builds NETMSG 0xbd(189) with server_type/server_subtype, allocates a cat-0x108 ticket (CommLayer_AllocTicketId holding an AssignServerTicketData) -> ticket_id, then sends; registers the ticket on success. The stub's 189->170/192 assign replies key off this.

GameServerManager::OnGameServerAssigned (cat 0x108): if the descriptor is the REFEREE server (type@+0x28==4 && subtype@+0x29==5), fires the assigned callback (server id) via handler vtbl[0x20]; else forwards to the default handler (this+4 vtbl[0x28]). The type4/subtype5 gate is why the stub's referee 170 must echo those and sets LM+0x580.

Handles UserComm server data (NETMSG 192/0xc0): caches the server blob at this+0x40 (len +0x44), sets state(+8)=2, dials the advertised address (this+0x24 vtbl[0xc] vtbl[0x80]) -> conn handle at +0x28; on failure(-1) resets state=0 and fires the error callback. Driven by the stub's 192 advertisement.
